desc: Establish safe bounds for alternating sums using `sum(nums)` so impossible targets can be rejected early.
Derive the required DP dimensions: alternating sum, selected-length parity, exact product, and non-empty status.
Design and implement a product-indexed bitset DP with separate per-element layers, including positive and zero transitions.
Validate the DP on the provided examples and edge cases involving zero, one, target zero, overflow products, and products at the limit.
Analyze worst-case time and memory complexity and provide the final Python `Solution.maxProduct` code.
